name: Camponaraya (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, red, white and blue, the red charged with five white scallop shells.
history: The flag and arms of Camponaraya were approved by agreement of the town council of 22 October 2001, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 8 November 2001; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of five horizontal stripes.

features.role: five scallop shells in a row
